notes.title: FLASH-BANG BUG FIXED!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Thank you so much for buying One More Night: BiO Clinic game!
I'm sorry for everyone who are experiencing the "flash-bang" bug. It's annoying but it already fixed!

Please get to me if anything wrong inside the game and give me any suggestion if anything can be more improved!

Thank you!

Can you survive for One More Night?

notes.title: UPDATE NEW VERSION!
notes.content:
Hello guys,

Thank you for anyone who bought this game!
I hope you can enjoy on finding how to finish the game by your own :)

First of all, there is a bug in the first version of the game and I'm truly sorry for that.

Second, the latest bug-free version is uploaded and yours to download!

For anyone who just visit this page, do not hesitate to bought this game and I dare you to find out on how to finish this clueless game ;)

Can you survive for One More Night?
